scope: Actual phone iframe routes; each measurement validates language, route owner and complete source-derived case IDs. Representative interactions are listed separately; this is not an assertion that every event in every scenario was manually exercised.

interactions.action: Type into the first visual comparison input
interactions.result: All three specimens receive the same value.

interactions.action: Enter a name, select fixed width and responsive columns
interactions.result: One form model retains the entered name; mobile width remains 346px.

interactions.action: Click the first indicator comparison Next slide button
interactions.result: All five carousels show 2 of 3 and the shared status reads Slide: 2.
Current changes from 5 to 6; adjacent total and jumper specimens remain unchanged.

interactions.action: Open custom-width dialog and click Cancel
interactions.result: One dialog opens, then all Close dialog controls disappear after its closing transition.

interactions.action: Render the geometry comparison in the real browser
interactions.result: Seven watermark backgrounds contain generated data:image content; gap, offset and rotation scenes all render.

interactions.action: Click a visual preset in Cedar English docs and the real Maple phone iframe
interactions.result: The message becomes visible; Cedar also closes and reopens it with another preset.

interactions.action: Select step 3 and error status in the English phone comparison
interactions.result: All four types show Done as active and one error node; both language pages remain 346px wide.
